_comment: COMEDY ATLAS ticket-referral config (D1, docs/ATLAS_ROADMAP_DECISIONS_2026-07-16.md). Single source of truth for go.html's outbound-redirect allowlist + affiliate params. Read at click time by go.html AND by scripts/atlas_ticket_clicks_report.py's tests -- keep both in sync by editing this one file, no regeneration step needed. ALLOWED_TICKET_HOSTS is derived from every hostname actually present in exports/upcoming_events.json's canonical_event_url column as of 2026-07-16 (eventbrite.com/.fr, freefestival.co.uk, freefringe.org.uk) plus meetup.com (an active collector target, see pipeline/registry.py, not yet appearing in live data). 2026-07-19 (ADR-021, organizer trust extended to EVENT_ADDITION): eventbrite.de and comedycafe.nl added -- the first live ticket-URL hosts from the newly organizer-trusted Berlin/Munich Eventbrite feeds and an Amsterdam club's own official ticketing site, surfaced by tests/test_atlas_partner_config.py against the freshly regenerated live export. 2026-07-19 (migration 0097, Dublin default_language backfill): eventbrite.ie added -- the first live ticket-URL host from Hysteria Comedy Club / the Comedy Nomad / The Laughter Factory's Dublin Eventbrite listings, now publishable once those orgs' default_language stopped sitting NULL; surfaced the same way by the same test. 2026-07-19 (close-out batch, item 1): eventbrite.be and eventbrite.ca added -- both already present in the live regenerated exports/upcoming_events.json (Brussels and a Canadian Eventbrite feed) and flagged missing by test_every_ticket_url_host_in_live_export_is_allowlisted; same trusted Eventbrite platform as every other eventbrite.* entry already on this list, just new country TLDs. 2026-07-26 (F0, REVENUE_READINESS_AUDIT_2026-07-26.md): the first FOUR self-ticketing club hosts added -- newyorkcomedyclub.com (21 events), ccu.stageti.me (Comedy Corner Underground Minneapolis, 21), eastvillecomedy.com (20), thetinycupboard.com (15). These four US rooms were onboarded and published earlier the same day WITHOUT this step, so go.html's fail-closed host check refused all 77 of their ticket links -- 100% of the US expansion was listed but unbuyable. test_every_ticket_url_host_in_live_export_is_allowlisted had been failing and was not read. US clubs self-ticket on their own domains rather than through Eventbrite, so unlike every earlier entry this list will now grow with EVERY new US room: adding the host is a MANDATORY step of the venue-onboarding recipe, not an afterthought. Add a host here BEFORE it can appear as a working ticket link -- this is a safety allowlist, not a discovery mechanism.

PARTNER_PARAMS._comment: '*' applies to every outbound host; a bare hostname key applies only to that host and is merged over '*'. Empty today by design (no affiliate deal exists yet, D1) -- populate then no page regeneration is needed since go.html reads this file at click time.
